invariants.rationale: The method cannot load a map without a filename; typically, a null fileName would be an error.
A non-empty filename is likely required to resolve a file.
Filenames that are only whitespace are not valid and would not resolve to real files.
TMX/JSON are typical Tiled map formats; fileName should likely have a compatible extension.
Filenames should not contain null characters, as these are invalid in file names.
